sources.title: Ollama: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct - Ollama | Model Documentation - langmart.ai
sources.snippet: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct is Meta's state-of-the-art instruction-tuned language model with 8 billion parameters. It's a compact yet powerful model designed for general-purpose conversational AI, reasoning tasks, and instruction following.

sources.title: llama-3.1-8b-instruct Model by Meta | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Model Information The Meta Llama 3.1 collection of multilingual large language models (LLMs) is a collection of pretrained and instruction tuned generative models in 8B, 70B and 405B sizes (text in/text out). The Llama 3.1 instruction tuned text only models (8B, 70B, 405B) are optimized for multilingual dialogue use cases and outperform many of the available open source and closed chat models ...

sources.title: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Use the 8B model when you need efficient inference on consumer hardware, lower latency, and lower cost, accepting a meaningful quality trade-off on difficult reasoning tasks. Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct by meta-llama is Meta's flagship model with 405 billion parameters, achieving state-of-the-art scores across nearly all benchmarks.
